reviews.text: Petland Jardins is a place I truly trust to take care of my dog. 🐾❤️ I take her there for baths and grooming and I'm always very calm because the whole team is extremely careful, responsible, attentive, and loving with the animals. I've also needed the services of the clinic's veterinarians and I only have praise for them. They are very competent and attentive professionals, and above all, they inspire a lot of security and confidence. It's wonderful to find a place where we know our pets will be treated with all the care and affection they deserve. The whole team is always very friendly and helpful. I recommend them without hesitation! ❤️
My puppy has been getting baths at Petland Jardins for years. I have complete confidence in their work. 🐶 …
Excellent service at reception and also from the groomers, with excellent care for my pet. Always attentive.
Wonderful store, excellent service, top-notch.

I have always been (and still am) very well received by the team.
Tito is treated with great affection and attention.

I'm very picky about the people I trust with my dog, Naná. Petland and the entire team have been completely trusted by me for many years now! Naná is loved, well-treated, and carefully looked after. This applies from the reception staff to the veterinarian, and of course, the grooming staff. Thank you for your impeccable and loving work!
Thank you for your feedback.
Very professional service, but also full of affection for our pets and their owners. I highly recommend them!

Top-notch professionals!!

Lots of natural treats and options for pets with allergies.

They also offer ozone therapy during pet baths!!
They are very attentive!

Very careful and attentive. I use their pick-up and drop-off service and they put my puppy in a super cute little basket so he doesn't get dirty. Plus, their WhatsApp service is very fast and efficient.

My furry friends are very well taken care of at Petland Jardins. I am immensely grateful for the kindness and care of the reception staff, groomers, and veterinary team. They are very attentive to my dog ​​and cat (she doesn't get bathed, but she is a patient of the vets). Perhaps not everyone knows, but it's possible to have blood tests and imaging done there, so I also recommend the support team. My dog ​​only has one complaint: she wants more treats after her bath, haha.
All the staff at Petland Jardins are very kind. They work with great care for my little dog, an older gentleman who requires special attention. The baths are always done perfectly and quickly!
Incredible service and attention. The staff are always very careful with the puppy. I wouldn't trade it for anywhere else.
The service is excellent!! Best pet shop in the region.

My dog ​​loves this pet shop so much that she practically drags me down the street to go! 😅 When we arrive, she throws the biggest party, like she's visiting friends!

The girls there are so sweet, they treat her with so much love and care, you can see the love they put into what they do. And she always comes home smelling wonderful, looking beautiful and happy 🥰

Complete trust! I recommend them without hesitation 💖🐾
The service is wonderful, they are super friendly and treat the animals very well.
I highly recommend them. Very attentive, excellent service, and high-quality products and services.

Excellent professionals. I'm usually hesitant to take my dog ​​to places I've never been before because he has special needs, but they treated us very well, and Bartho approved. I will definitely take him again.
Amazing service, and best of all, my pets love their baths at Petland Jardins! The care and attention they receive is wonderful! 🐶🐶🥰🥰 …
Rico (my dog) and I love how well we are treated there!

We love it when our little pug, Stallone, comes back from his bath at Petland Jardins! He smells wonderful and his fur is so loose and flowing! The bath is always very thorough: clean ears and trimmed nails! We noticed that the use of ozone water worked wonders in reducing itching! All the staff are very attentive and friendly! And the veterinarian, Dr. Mariana, is great!

Excellent service! Always pleasant!
Best Pet Shop in Jardim Paulista!
Excellent staff!
Excellent at taking care of my pets.

Excellent service!

They are all very attentive and always do their best to accommodate schedules, even when their agenda is full. The service is always provided with great kindness and care. You can feel the affection and professionalism with which they treat the pets and the clients. I highly recommend them!

My furry friend is treated with so much love. The team is not only technically excellent, but they are also very attentive. There's a personal touch in everything, to the point that they even let me know when her deworming medication is due or when her favorite food arrives. Thank you for taking such good care of her!

The whole team is very attentive, they are super careful, the place is super clean, and my little dog always comes back very happy and very well cared for by Rio Ricardo (groomer). Bathing, grooming, the shop and the veterinarian Mariana... everyone deserves praise! I recommend them without hesitation!
I have always received excellent service.
Thank you for your feedback! It's a great pleasure to know that you like and trust our services; it's always a joy to serve you.
Thank you for your feedback! It's a great pleasure to know that you like and trust our services; it's always a joy to serve you.
Fantastic work!
A perfect score! Extremely attentive and kind professionals, and impeccable service (bathing/grooming)! I highly recommend them!!!!
Petland is great! Café, my little toy, is always treated super well. The staff is caring and patient with him -- he doesn't like baths at all, but he comes back clean and smelling great.
Good service and professionals who care about animal welfare.
My Gigi is always well cared for and smells nice, I love it! Excellent service, when it rains the guy picks her up to put her in the car, very kind!
The pet shop is great!! Everyone is very attentive and careful with our pet children. Mel, my Yorkshire Terrier, usually gets weekly baths and always smells wonderful and looks beautiful!!

They are great! My dog ​​has been getting baths there since it opened! The staff are lovely, kind, and very affectionate with him!!

Fair price and excellent service.
Thank you for your feedback! It's a great pleasure to know that you like and trust our services; it's always a joy to serve you.
Best Pet! Super attentive to the animals and their owners. Always ready to help. Super clean environment and highly trained professionals. I highly recommend them!

One of the best pet grooming centers I've ever been to. Very complete facilities. The staff is top-notch, attentive, and gives my pets their full attention. They're here every week. Excellent precision and quality of service is what matters …
My dogs came out smelling wonderful, with trimmed nails, and I've never seen so many treat options for dogs with allergies, 1000/10!
I've been a regular for a long time. First it was Zampa, always very well cared for, and now Maggie, a baby who is very spoiled by everyone.
Thank you for your feedback! It's a great pleasure to know that you like and trust our services; it's always a joy to serve you.
